gap: By default, the keyboard focus indicator is the ripple or a background tint, and its contrast can fall below 3:1
workaround: Enable `focusVisible` in your theme — see below

gap: Some default palette colors fall short of contrast minimums

affected.note: `info`, `warning`; label on the focus ripple: use `disableFocusRipple` with the ring
focused `info`, `warning`; `error` on a dark Paper with elevation 2 or more

workaround: Override the affected palette entries. In dark mode, set a lighter `error.main`, or keep `error` text on a surface with elevation 0 or 1. Elevation does not help the label of a `filled` TextField

gap: The selected state of colored Toggle Buttons is conveyed almost entirely by hue
workaround: Add a non-color cue to the selected state, such as an icon

gap: The extended Fab has a fixed height, so a label that wraps can spill out of it
workaround: Keep labels short, or set `height: 'auto'`, `minHeight: 48`, and vertical padding with `sx`

gap: A required checkbox, radio, or switch group exposes no required state to assistive technology, because Checkbox, Radio, and Switch do not take `required` from FormControl and RadioGroup has no `required` prop
workaround: Set `aria-required` on a RadioGroup. Set `required` on a single Checkbox or Switch, or on its FormControlLabel, which forwards it to the control. For a checkbox group, state the requirement in the legend text

gap: Links without an underline rely on color, and several link colors are below 3:1 against body text
workaround: Keep the default `underline="always"` for links in body text

gap: Dynamic state changes are not announced

workaround: Show it only while an operation is in flight

gap: A focused button that turns `loading` loses keyboard focus to the page
workaround: Move focus to a nearby element before you set `loading`, and back when it ends
